title: Apex — Time Trial Garage
description: Draw a circuit, tune a car, then chase your own ghost around it — lap times, replays and shareable tracks.
concept: Apex is a pocket time-trial game with the track editor built in. Drive mode runs an arcade car model with a real tyre-friction limit, times every lap and replays your best lap as a translucent ghost beside you with a live delta. Build mode turns the same circuit into a spline you can drag, extend, trim and randomise, then export as JSON or a poster-style PNG map. Garage mode tunes power, grip, steering and brakes live while you drive, and any circuit plus setup packs into a share link.
features: Drive mode: lap timer, sector gating, best-lap store and a ghost car replaying your fastest lap with a live delta
Build mode: drag, insert and delete spline nodes, width and smoothing sliders, randomiser, pan and pinch-zoom
Garage mode: four chassis presets plus live power / grip / steering / brake sliders and five liveries
Three built-in circuits plus your own, with per-track best times and ghosts kept in localStorage
Export the circuit as .json or a poster .png map, or copy a share link with track and setup baked into the URL hash

interaction.mouse: In Build mode drag nodes to reshape the circuit, drag the background to pan, scroll to zoom.
interaction.click: Mode tabs switch Drive / Build / Garage; chips pick circuits, tools, chassis and livery; buttons export JSON, PNG and share links.
interaction.touch: On-screen pads steer, throttle and brake above the dock; pinch to zoom and drag nodes in Build mode.
interaction.keyboard: Arrows or WASD to drive, Space for handbrake, R to reset the car, 1/2/3 to jump between modes.
